about: Every GET route that writes state, and why. A GET that writes makes that state depend on whether anyone read. This list only shrinks: arch Phase 4 design section 5 names each owner, and test/no-get-route-writes-state.test.ts refuses a new entry and a stale one.

entries.reason: appendCreditStateTransition ledgers account.credit_state on each credit-state edge, so an edge is recorded only if someone happens to read.
entries.owner: the slow lane's host probe derives the edge and appends it once, with or without a reader (P4-T14)

entries.reason: reconcileFeedbackEntries flips an entry whose proposal PR merged to accepted (and lands it in production), one writer per concurrent GET.
entries.owner: the feedback materializer in the slow lane, triggered by a gateway generation showing the PR merged (P4-T07)
